definitions.explanation: Anime productions released directly to home video (DVD/Blu-ray) rather than being broadcast on TV or shown in theaters.

examples.japanese: OVAが{発売|はつばい}された。
TV{版|ばん}より{先|さき}にOVAが{出|で}た。
examples.english: The OVA came out before the TV version.

examples.japanese: このシリーズはOVAで{完結|かんけつ}する。
examples.english: This series will conclude with an OVA.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Abbreviation of 'Original Video Animation'. Also sometimes called OAV (Original Animation Video).

USAGE:
OVAs often feature:
・Higher production quality than TV anime
・More mature content
・Side stories or sequels to popular series
・Adaptations of manga that are too short for TV

COLLOCATIONS:
・OVA{化|か} - OVA adaptation
・OVA{版|ばん} - OVA version
